finding.headline: "The Babywearing-Wrapper Neck"
finding.problem: "I tie my baby and my shoulders round forward, my neck aches, my tummy pushes out. The wrapper that helps me also hurts me."
finding.person: Aisha, 28, carries baby in traditional wrapper on one hip/back; rounded shoulders, anterior pelvic tilt, core disengaged.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Module (posture + babywearing) — bundle component". Verdict: PASSES.
